newsitem.title: USA: New Plan buys 4 properties for $45 mln.
newsitem.headline: New Plan buys 4 properties for $45 mln.

text.p: New Plan Realty Trust said Thursday it bought one residential and three retail properties for a total of $45 million.
The trust said it has acquired 25 properties for a total of $234 million so far this year and expects "significant additional closings" before the end of July.
New Plan said it now owns shopping centers with a total of 19.2 million square feet retail space and 10,964 apartment units.

The three shopping centers include: a Jacksonville, Fla., center with 329,500 square feet of retail space; a Bethel Park, Pa., center with 206,000 square feet of retail space; and a Roanoke, Va. center with 167,000 square feet.
The residential property is a 288-unit apartment community in Columbus, Ohio.
Shares in New Plan traded at 22-1/8 Thursday morning, up 1/16.
